note: Replaces the broken wnba-spread-baseline-v1.json which used baseline_heuristic with coefficients [1.0] on elo_margin — that model predicted moneyline (who wins), not spread (who covers), and never conditioned on the spread line. This replacement uses BasketballModel's normal CDF approach: P(away covers) = Φ(spread_away_line; expected_margin, 10.5), correctly conditioning on the spread line.

qualification.note: Replacement baseline for the broken wnba-spread-baseline-v1. Uses the same BasketballModel spread logic as the live WNBA model (wnba-elo-trend-v1), which computes away_cover = normal_cdf(spread_away_line, expected_margin, margin_sd=10.5). Not yet qualified — backtest pending.
